method: Read the currently served static frontend asset through the existing authenticated browser session; inspect fixed capability-name consumers, not merely search hits or emulator-reflected bootstrap values.
limitations: This supports the property spellings and stated current UI consumer contexts. It does not establish backend wire-schema completeness, default values, task support, feature quality or every enabled/version field in the implementation. No proprietary source expression is reproduced.
